products.quality: Reference-grade seam control: Set Start Point tool moves seam to any node, Shift-click or Edit > Reverse Shape Direction flips direction; Edit Nodes adds seam nodes; optimizer can auto-choose start/direction. Community guides show routine use.
N/R - CNC-only product; no laser toolpath generation (phase0 coverage notes: product page lists only CNC control targets).

Vector line cutting exists via Inkscape-tuned SVG import and vectorization; vectorizer emits internal paths before external for cutting. No seam/start-point or direction controls documented anywhere in official usage docs [INF from absence].

xTool Studio Cut processing type on vectors; closed shapes detected via <=0.05 mm endpoint-gap rule (kerf doc). No start-point, seam, or cut-direction control documented [INF from absence across support articles].
Outside sector: Easel generates CNC spindle toolpaths only; no native laser mode. Laser vendor J Tech recommends LightBurn instead of Easel; forum laser use is a workaround.

Outside sector: no laser fill/hatch generation; CNC pocketing is spindle-based.
